title: [dogfood:P1] Compliance gate h3-test install/run undocumented in README
detail: README only links get-h3/shim ('Must pass h3-test') with no install or battery command; the working invocation (clone shim, pip install -e ., h3-test --endpoint http://localhost:9191) lives only in umbrella AGENTS.md. I ran the battery against the quickstart harness: 45/45 PASSED, exit 0, 0.23s, p50 0.97ms — the gate works, but a new user cannot discover how to run it from the SDK README.

title: [dogfood:P1] testbed package has zero usage example; constructor/signatures require source reading

Roundtrip test passed once signature known (ok, 0.002s).

title: [dogfood:P1] make lint is a false green without a linter installed
detail: Makefile lint recipe: 'golangci-lint run ./... 2>/dev/null || staticcheck ./... 2>/dev/null || echo "lint: no linter available"' — exits 0 and prints a success-looking line even when neither linter exists. Verified live: no golangci-lint/staticcheck on PATH, make lint exited 0. New users get a fake quality signal.

title: [dogfood:P2] Battery count stale: umbrella AGENTS.md and shim docstring say 44, actual run is 45/45
detail: get-h3/AGENTS.md and shim/src/h3_shim/test_battery.py docstring both say '44 tests across 6 categories' while the file sets EXPECTED_TEST_COUNT=45 and my live run reported 45/45 (7+8+6+7+12+5). SDK README correctly says 45/45. Doc drift across the umbrella, not a code defect.

title: [dogfood:P2] cmd/gen-types ships with no --help/usage; bare invocation fails cryptically
detail: go run ./cmd/gen-types --help prints 'no schema files found' and exits 1 (no usage text); bare run prints 'usage: gen-types <schema_glob>...' then exits 1. Correct invocation (go run ./cmd/gen-types 'protocol/schemas/v1/*.json' → 15 files validated) is discoverable only via the //go:generate comment in protocol/types.go. h3-consensus-adapter, by contrast, has proper -flag help.
